faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Hindustan Shipyard (HSL), a prominent government organization involved in shipbuilding and repair activities in India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this HSL recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Medical Officer (FTC), which stands for Fixed Term Contract. It is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Medical Officer (FTC) posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Medical Officer (FTC) post in the Hindustan Shipyard recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for HSL Medical Officer (FTC) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Medical Officer (FTC) post is Online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official HSL website.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for the HSL Medical Officer (FTC) post?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission of the application form for the Medical Officer (FTC) position is 25 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Medical Officer (FTC) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree and be registered with the Indian Medical Council. A PG Degree/Diploma in any medical discipline is desirable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the HSL Medical Officer (FTC) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants for the Medical Officer (FTC) post is 50 years. There is no specific minimum age mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Medical Officer (FTC) post at HSL?
faq.answer: The salary for the Medical Officer (FTC) post is Rs. 90,000/- per month (CTC - All Inclusive). This is a competitive remuneration package.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application fee for the HSL Medical Officer (FTC) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs.300/- for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories. Candidates need to pay this fee during the online application process.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the HSL Medical Officer (FTC) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two main stages: shortlisting based on marks obtained in the qualifying examination, followed by a personal interview for the shortlisted candidates.
